Necromancy Overview
Necromancy
is a combat skill that focuses on creating undead and wielding dark magic. To use necromancy you must have an item with a "Necromancy Gem" equipped and you also cannot have a "Holy Symbol" Equipped.
All skeleton-summon abilities require
Necromancy Dust
(Level 2 recipe). There are certain "designated" graveyards (examples are the main entrance of
Serbule Crypt
,
Eltibule Crypt
), but otherwise a "graveyard" is any area with at least 3 player tombstones in close proximity (to be verified since the update modify summoning aspect of Necromancy. Once summoned, skeleton minions will be resummoned when you move to a different zone.
In-Game Description
Necromancy is control over the undead, along with other powers that trifle with mortality. To use necromantic abilities, you must be wielding or wearing a necromancy gem. You can often find these on weapons, and less often on pieces of armor. (If you are in a beast form, necromancy gems in weapons won't work, but ones in armor will.)
Training Necromancy
The skill is learned by going into the
Serbule Crypt
, defeating
Khyrulek's True Form
and delivering
an item
from the boss's drops to the
Pulsing Crystal
. When you do this, you will be given a "Necromancy Test Staff" and a "Necromancy Test Necklace". Both have necromancy gems in them, so you can choose one to equip and start using Necromancy.
Jumjab
teaches
Heart's Power
1-2,
Wave of Darkness
1-5
Daniel Murderdark
will unlock Necromancy 51-60, unlock 61-70, and teach level 51+ abilities
Bogaku
can teach you the secrets of raising Ratkin Skeleton Mages
Bendith the Banished
can unlock 71-80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Reinath
deep beneath
Povus
.
You can learn

from scrolls

Related Skills:
Necromancy is a very diverse skill. It has mods that support many skill combos. Necro pets can help cover the issues that specialising in one damage type can cause as well. Here are some skills that combo well:
Battle Chemistry
is an interesting choice. Both have indirect fire mods. You can also apply mutations to your pets. Giving a zombie thick skin can almost completely negate the passive bleed. Very diverse damage type access.
Fire Magic
works quite well. Both skills have indirect fire mods. Deaths hold can be modded to apply a burn DOT as well. Your pets can lean into fire damage even more or can diversify your damage types
Mentalism
makes a very effective electric DPS if you have
Fairy Magic
. Deaths Hold and Spark of death can both be modded to apply electric vulns. Also has psychic DOT mod Synergy as well
Spirit Fox
. Dark Damage specialist. Both have access to Darkness vulns. Also has a litte indirect fire synergy.
Sword
can make an effective slashing DPS. Deaths hold has a slashing vuln and Skeleton warriors can push more slashing damage.
Vampirism
can be used to lean hard into Dark Damage. Both skills have access to darkness vulns. Very capable solo as well due to the CC and pets combo.
Warden
can work in a similar fashion to mentalism. Both skills have access to electric vulns. Indirect fire is another theme that both skills share. Could work well with fire or Ratkin mages. Coordinated Assault mods work?
Weather Witching
is a fantastic option. Hybrid Electric/Dark specialisation. Doomstorms count as undead minions and can benefit from all of the necro pet skills. Both can apply electric vulns. Best with Ratkin mages.
